verdict.rationale: USPTO operates a real machine endpoint at api.uspto.gov, which returns a structured API-key auth challenge, and serves a developer portal at developer.uspto.gov. Patent Center docs also acknowledge users making direct API calls to its Workbench/view-application surfaces, so a public API exists. However, the evidence never shows which operations the API covers; the documented core workflows (filing, payment, responding to correspondence) are described only through web UIs behind MFA and identity verification. The developer docs are also unreadable without JavaScript, and no OpenAPI spec was found. missing for 10: evidence of what operations the API documents (especially filing, status tracking and payment), a machine-readable spec (OpenAPI) or plain-text docs, a documented key-issuance and auth flow, independent or hands-on corroboration of driving workflows via the API.
